title: Kernel discipline: fips_gate called under spinlock in fips_aggregate
description: crypto2dev_fips_aggregate() (registry.c:296) calls p->algos[i]->fips_gate() while holding read_lock(&provider_lock), which is a spinlock-based rwlock. wolfssl_fips_gate() calls pr_err_ratelimited() on the non-operational path (wolfssl_provider.c:33), which acquires an internal ratelimit spinlock. On PREEMPT_RT kernels all spinlocks become sleeping locks, making this sleeping-in-atomic-context. Even on non-RT kernels, the API contract for fips_gate callbacks does not document the 'no-sleep, no-lock' requirement that holding a spinlock imposes on callees. Any future fips_gate implementation that uses a mutex, kmalloc, or other sleepable primitive will silently break. Fix: snapshot FIPS state before releasing the lock, or switch provider_lock to a mutex.
